Our story goes back more than 150 years, to the chilly southern coast of Scandinavia. From our early success in Sweden and Denmark, we’ve grown into the world’s leading specialist producer of plant-based oils, employing more than 4,000 people across the globe.

We work with our customers to make the products you love even better. The oils we produce go into making your chocolate extra-creamy or putting the crunch into your croissant. And it’s not just food. We work across industries to make products that are higher quality, healthier and better for the planet.

Everything we do is about Making Better Happen™.

AAK Locations

This position is based at our site in Aarhus, Denmark. We offer a hybrid way of working.

About the role

As our Talent Acquisition Specialist in Denmark, you will have a unique opportunity to help shape and establish how Talent Acquisition is delivered locally, while being part of AAK’s growing European Talent Acquisition team.

You will take ownership of end-to-end recruitment across a broad range of functions and levels, combining hands-on recruitment with a strategic and consultative approach. Working closely with hiring managers and HR colleagues, you will bring market insights, recruitment expertise and constructive challenge to hiring decisions.

While Denmark will be your primary area of responsibility, you will also collaborate on recruitment projects and initiatives across other regions, giving you exposure to a broad range of stakeholders, functions and markets.

You will play an important role in attracting talent, strengthening AAK’s employer brand, delivering an excellent candidate experience, and continuously improving our recruitment processes and ways of working.

Responsibilities

- Manage end-to-end recruitment processes across professional and operational roles in Denmark.

- Partner closely with hiring managers and HR colleagues to understand talent needs and define effective recruitment strategies.

- Build proactive talent pipelines through sourcing, talent mapping, networking, and candidate engagement.

- Conduct interviews and assessments and support hiring managers in making high-quality, structured recruitment decisions.

- Provide talent market insights and constructively challenge stakeholders when needed to support inclusive, data-informed, and long-term hiring outcomes.

- Develop attractive job advertisements, contribute to employer branding activities, and ensure a professional and engaging candidate experience throughout the recruitment journey.

- Maintain recruitment data and systems and contribute to continuous improvement of recruitment processes and ways of working.

- Support recruitment across both professional and operational populations, including blue-collar recruitment.

- Manage relationships with recruitment agencies and external vendors to support quality, efficiency, and cost-effective partnerships.

- Collaborate with colleagues across the European Talent Acquisition team and contribute to broader recruitment projects and initiatives.

About you

You are an experienced Talent Acquisition professional who enjoys combining hands-on recruitment with a strategic and consultative approach. You build strong relationships with stakeholders, are comfortable constructively challenging when needed, and enjoy working in an international and evolving environment.

To succeed in this role, we believe you bring:

- Solid experience independently managing end-to-end recruitment processes, from initial briefing through to hire.

- Strong experience in proactive sourcing and candidate engagement, including LinkedIn Recruiter and talent mapping.

- Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.

- A good understanding of structured selection methods and assessment tools.

- Experience working with Applicant Tracking Systems.

- Excellent communication skills in both Danish and English.

- An interest in working across multiple functions, countries, and cultures.

- Experience from manufacturing, production, FMCG, or another industrial environment would be an advantage, as would experience managing recruitment agencies and external partners.

Contact and information

Please apply through our career portal. The deadline for applications is November 20, 2026.

For further information about the position, please contact: Linn Rubin, Talent Acquisition Specialist linn.rubin@aak.com or Sophie Rezaei, Global Talent Acquisition Manager, sophie.rezaei@aak.com.

About AAK

Everything AAK does is about Making Better Happen™. We specialize in plant-based oils that are the value-adding ingredients in many of the products people love to consume. We make these products better tasting, healthier, and more sustainable.

At the heart of AAK’s offer is Customer Co-Development, combining our desire to understand what better means for each customer, with the unique flexibility of our production assets, and deep knowledge of many products and industries, including Chocolate and confectionery, Bakery, Dairy, Plant-based Foods, Special Nutrition, Foodservice and Personal Care.

Our 4,000 employees support our close collaboration with customers through 25 regional sales offices, 15 dedicated Customer Innovation Centers, and the support of more than 20 production facilities. Listed on Nasdaq Stockholm and with our headquarters in Malmö, Sweden, AAK has been Making Better Happen™ for more than 150 years.

jobs.description:
Help build reliable technology that powers sports experiences around the world.

At Trackman, we develop innovative technology used by athletes, coaches, and sports facilities worldwide. Behind these experiences are business-critical platforms that make it easy for customers to book, pay, and access our services.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to help strengthen the quality, reliability, and scalability of our booking, payments, and commerce solutions. You will work closely with developers, product owners, and quality engineers to ensure that our solutions deliver a seamless experience to customers around the world.

This role is ideal for an experienced automation engineer who enjoys building robust test frameworks, improving engineering practices, and working on business-critical payment solutions.

What You'll Do

• 
Design, develop, and maintain automated test solutions using Playwright and TypeScript.

• 
Build UI, API, integration, and end-to-end automated tests for booking and payment services.

• 
Drive risk-based testing and quality engineering practices across the product lifecycle.

• 
Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, and help define and maintain quality gates

• 
Collaborate closely with developers, product owners, and quality engineers to improve testability and overall product quality.

• 
Identify quality risks early through requirement reviews and technical discussions.

• 
Mentor and support team members in test automation and quality engineering best practices.

• 
Continuously improve automation coverage, reliability, and execution efficiency.

Job requirements

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who combines strong technical expertise with a proactive and collaborative approach to quality engineering.

• 
5+ years of experience as an SDET, Test Automation Engineer, or Quality Engineer.

• 
Experience with payment, e-commerce, subscription, billing, POS, or financial transaction platforms.

• 
Strong hands-on experience with Playwright and TypeScript.

• 
Experience testing REST and GraphQL APIs and backend services.

• 
Experience integrating and maintaining automated tests within CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar tools.

• 
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.

AI & Emerging Technologies

• Experience with AI and machine learning concepts and an understanding of how they can be applied within a quality engineering context.

Nice to Have

• 
Experience testing integrations with payment gateways such as Adyen, Stripe, PayPal, or Nets.

• 
Experience with AWS or other cloud platforms.

• 
Experience with performance, load, or security testing.

• 
Experience working in Agile product teams.

• 
Interest in sports technology or SaaS products.

The Office

We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

Where innovation happens

At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

Share our Passion!

Our engineering ecosystem brings together specialist knowledge, training, documentation and software.

Your background

• Strong analytical skills across mechanical function, tolerance variation, and solid mechanics.

• Knowledge of Robust Design principles.

• Knowledge of production technologies and Design for Manufacturing (DFM).

• Fluent English.

Additional experience we value

• Working knowledge of statistical methods and finite element simulation methods.

• Experience with prototyping tools and methods.

• Strong communication and presentation skills.

• Danish or German language skills.

• Advanced simulation expertise.

Location and travel

This is a hybrid role based at our headquarters at Strandboulevarden 122, 3rd floor, 2100 Copenhagen, Denmark.

Expect 0–20 travel days per year.

Why join RD8

• Work alongside Robust Design specialists on mechanical challenges across products and industries.

• Have a high degree of freedom in how you approach your work and contribute to the methods and tools we develop.

• Flexibility to work from home when project and client commitments allow, with support for a home office setup

The Company

˚MEQU is a Danish MedTech company behind the ˚M Warmer System, an innovative medical device that enables healthcare professionals to deliver warm blood and IV-fluids from the point of injury to the hospital. With customers across military, tactical, emergency, HEMS, and hospital environments worldwide, our ambition is to become the global leader in blood and IV-fluid warming solutions for pre-hospital and through hospital care. Learn more about ˚MEQU: www.mequ.dk

On behalf of ˚MEQU, Best Talent is recruiting an International Product Manager.

The Team

You will join a small, ambitious Marketing team with ambitious plans and great impact on the future growth of the company. Success is driven by close collaboration across Marketing, R&D, QA/RA, Operations, and Commercial functions in a fast moving and highly cross-functional environment.

International Product Manager

Drive global product strategy for an innovative Danish MedTech company

• Shape life-saving MedTech solutions through your clinical expertise

• Collaborate with leading healthcare providers, emergency services, and military organizations

• Play a key role in the international growth of a fast-scaling Danish MedTech company with a meaningful and global purpose

The Role

We are looking for an International Product Manager who can bridge clinical insights, users’ needs, regulatory requirements, and technical development to drive successful global product strategies and commercial execution.

You will own the global product lifecycle across emergency, tactical, and hospital segments. With the United States representing ˚MEQU’s most important growth market, you will play a key role in ensuring that product positioning, roadmap priorities, and value propositions algin with the clinical, regulatory, and commercial requirements of US military, EMS, HEMS, and hospital customers.

Working across the organization, you will ensure that user insights, market needs, engineering priorities and regulatory considerations are translated into clear product direction and commercially viable solutions.

As the internal subject-matter expert within pre-hospital blood and IV transfusion, you will convert clinical challenges into prioritized product requirements that guide product development and long-term portfolio decisions. The position reports directly to the COO and requires approximately 30-50 travel days annually.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Shaping global product positioning, value propositions, and market prioritization to support successful international expansion, and continuously monitor:

• Developments in clinical standards of care.

• Tactical and military medical protocols.

• Global procurement and reimbursement structures.

• Competitive and technological developments.

• International market dynamics and commercial opportunities.

• Develop instructions for use, training materials, user guides, and educational content to support sales teams, distributors, and clinical specialists globally.

Your professional background:

You bring a clinical background within emergency medicine, pre-hospital care, HEMS, military medicine, or tactical care, combined with hands-on experience with blood and IV transfusion in critical settings. You understand the realities and challenges faced by end users in high-pressure environments.

In addition, you have commercial insight into the MedTech industry and experience supporting product positioning, launches, and international market development. Experience working with institutional customers medical device markets and understand how to position, launch, and scale products internationally. Experience with institutional and public procurement structures is highly valued.

You understand medical device development and the regulatory environment and are able to translate complex clinical needs into structured product requirements that create both customers value and commercial impact.

Your personality – You are:

• A strong communicator with who bridges clinical technical, regulatory, and commercial perspectives.

• Commercially minded with a strategic and customer-centric approach

• Structured and analytical, with the ability to balance long-term strategy and operational execution

• Proactive, self-driven, and comfortable taking ownership in a dynamic scale-up environment

• Curious, collaborative, and motivated by improving patient outcomes through innovation

˚MEQU offers you:

You will gain international exposure across tactical, emergency, and hospital markets and collaborate closely with global distributors, armed forces, and leading healthcare institutions.

• A high-impact position with global strategic product influence

• A dynamic, international, and collaborative work environment

• A diverse team of 30+ colleagues headquartered in Copenhagen

• A mission-driven culture focused on improving patient outcomes

• Competitive salary with a pension scheme and up-to-date benefits

Application:

Please send your application in English, marked ”1947/International Product Manager” to job@besttalent.dk. Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Learn more about Best Talent at www.besttalent.dk.

As AI Delivery Lead, you are responsible for how AI initiatives are delivered – ensuring flow, execution and predictable delivery from idea to production. You work in close collaboration with the AI Product Owner, who owns the what and why, while you own the how and delivery.

In this hybrid role, you will balance driving day-to-day team execution with hands-on contribution to governance strategy.

You will work directly with cross-functional teams - data scientists, AI engineers, data engineers, platform engineers, AI enablement specialists, IT teams, and business stakeholders to ensure AI solutions are built, deployed, and adopted with high quality and speed.

You will also direct ownership of key governance tasks, guiding teams toward AI maturity, leading AI and Agent Governance assessments, and navigating compliance requirements for the EU AI Act.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

You will be responsible for making AI initiatives happen in practice, collaborating closely with teams across JYSK to drive both delivery execution and AI governance maturity.

Furthermore, we offer you:

• A hands-on delivery role with clear ownership of how AI solutions are delivered

• Direct impact on shaping JYSK's AI governance, Agent Governance, and EU AI Act compliance roadmap

• Close collaboration with an AI Product Owner and skilled technical specialists

• An international working environment with focus on execution and outcomes

• Opportunities for professional and personal development

• Freedom with responsibility in a values-driven organization

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

As AI Delivery Lead, you take operational ownership of AI deliveries and drive AI governance initiatives to ensure responsible and compliant deployment. Your key responsibilities include:

• Owning the end-to-end delivery of AI initiatives from planning to production

• Driving execution based on priorities set by the AI Product Owner

• Driving and facilitating planning and delivery activities (such as planning, refinement, daily stand-up, retrospective, demos, etc.)  to ensure steady flow and progress

• Coordinating work across the AI team, IT teams and business stakeholders

• Actively removing impediments and managing dependencies across initiatives

• Following development, progress closely and ensuring timely deployments and handovers

• Ensuring transparency on progress, risks and delivery status

• Supporting good delivery practices

• Leading compliance and maturity activities in AI Governance and Agent Governance

• Conducting AI assessments to ensure solutions align with governance frameworks

• Supporting and guiding teams toward full compliance with the EU AI Act

WHAT SHOULD YOU BRING

We are looking for a pragmatic and delivery-focused profile who thrives in execution and close collaboration. You enjoy being close to the work, driving team flow, and taking direct responsibility for AI governance and compliance. You likely bring:

• Hands-on experience delivering solutions within AI, machine learning, advanced analytics, data products and similar

• Experience from roles such as Delivery Lead, Scrum Master, Project Manager or similar

• Solid understanding of agile principles and cross-functional teamwork

• Knowledge of AI governance, Agent Governance, or compliance frameworks such as the EU AI Act

• Practical experience with AI assessments or quality assurance in data/AI initiatives

• Ability to collaborate closely with a Product Owner while maintaining clear role boundaries

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

• A structured, proactive and solution-oriented mindset

• Experience with JIRA or similar is considered an advantage, but not a must
